verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a SaaS fraud-protection platform with a merchant-facing app, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence covers only REST APIs, webhooks, SDKs, Decision Center policies and test teams, with no mention of an in-product AI assistant that users can hand tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
